name: Payment Methods
description: Saved cards drawn without network logos. The default outline travels when you change it, and removing a card leaves an undo in the list.

props.name: cards
props.type: { id: string; last4: string; expiry: string; holder: string }[]
props.description: The cards on file. Read on mount; adding and removing happen in the component.

props.name: defaultCardId
props.description: The card that pays, by id. Read on mount.

props.name: view
props.description: "add" opens the new-card form. Pass it with onViewChange to control the form; omit it and the list keeps its own.

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Called when the form opens or closes.

props.name: onDefaultChange
props.description: Called with the id of the card just made default.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Called when a card is removed. Undo puts it back locally.

props.name: onAdd
props.description: Called with the card the form just added.

props.name: workspace
props.description: Printed in small caps on every card.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the default card's outline, the Default label, and Add once the draft is valid.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink. The cards stay dark objects in both. Light deepens the accent for text.
